TRUEOS runs local speech on a single processor core. We are measuring the same sentence before and after preparing the model weights.

Local speech should respond quickly and sound natural. The assistant prepares the text, selects pronunciation, and generates audio using the bundled English voice. Each sentence is processed on a single core. This experiment keeps the words and voice unchanged while removing repeated preparation work. We compare the time spent calculating and verify that the generated audio remains exactly the same. Clear measurements will tell us which changes are useful.
